section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report August 19 2026
summary:
Main
Iron ore futures traded firmer today. The DCE most-active contract I2701 settled at RMB 712/mt, up 0.78% from the previous trading day.Spot prices at Qingdao Port declined by RMB 2-3/mt. Traders were reasonably active in offering, but mill purchases remained largely restocking on a just-in-need basis, leaving overall spot transactions fairly subdued.
